# multiagents Copilot Guidance

Read and follow the shared [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for architecture, Bun commands, change safety, and validation. Read [ECC workflow](../docs/ecc-workflow.md) when planning, reviewing, or verifying work.

The local `ecc-plan`, `ecc-review`, and `ecc-verify` prompt files are optional task templates, not native ECC commands or hooks. Their availability depends on the editor's prompt-file support. This file does not enable runtime ECC injection, install skills, or authorize external side effects.
